name: MetaWin
rootCause: According to on-chain detective ZachXBT, the cryptocurrency gambling platform MetaWin was reportedly attacked, resulting in the theft of over $4 million on the Ethereum and Solana blockchains.

descriptions.text: According to on-chain detective ZachXBT, the cryptocurrency gambling platform MetaWin was reportedly attacked, resulting in the theft of over $4 million on the Ethereum and Solana blockchains.

MetaWin’s November 3, 2024 hot-wallet exploit drained about $4 million from Ethereum and Solana wallets after an attacker abused its frictionless withdrawal flow. The public record supports unauthorized withdrawals and a temporary pause in withdrawals, but it does not disclose the exact technical authorization failure or any independently verified transaction trail. MetaWin’s withdrawal workflow allowed unauthorized access to its hot-wallet funds. The available record supports a failure in the withdrawal authorization path, but it does not establish the exact compromised credential, signer, or on-chain transaction sequence that enabled the drain.

Hot wallets used by the MetaWin crypto casino were drained of around $4 million. According to the company's CEO, the attacker "t[ook] advantage of our frictionless withdrawal system". The attacker then moved the stolen funds to crypto exchanges including KuCoin.
